page: Every serious walker carries a pencil. The notebook is not for others; it is a record of attention.
Write it down before it becomes an opinion.
css: :root { --accent: #b4235a; }
body { margin: 0; font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif; line-height: 1.6; color: #222; }
.site-header { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 16px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e5e5; }
.logo { font: 700 22px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; }
.nav a { margin-right: 16px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: #555; text-decoration: none; }
.nav a:hover { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; }
.nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 2px; }
article { max-width: 680px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px 20px; }
h1 { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 32px; line-height: 1.15; }
.byline { color: #767676; font-size: 14px; font-style: italic; }

.tag { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #f6e8ee; color: var(--accent); font: 600 12px/20px system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; }
blockquote { position: relative; margin: 32px 0; padding: 0 0 0 24px; border-left: 4px solid var(--accent); font-size: 20px; color: #444; }
blockquote::before { content: "\201C"; position: absolute; top: -20px; left: -8px; font-size: 64px; line-height: 1; color: rgba(180, 35, 90, 0.2); }
pre { padding: 16px; border-radius: 8px; overflow-x: auto; background: #1e1e2e; color: #cdd6f4; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; }

.button { display: inline-block; padding: 10px 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--accent); color: #fff; font: 600 15px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; }
.button:hover { background: #8f1c48; }
.button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(180, 35, 90, 0.4); outline-offset: 2px; }
.footer { padding: 32px 20px; border-top: 1px solid #eee; text-align: center; font-size: 14px; color: #767676; }
@media (min-width: 768px) {
.site-header { flex-direction: row; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; padding: 24px 40px; }
h1 { font-size: 44px; }
pre { padding: 20px 24px; font-size: 14px; }
@media (min-width: 1280px) {
article { max-width: 760px; padding: 48px 0; }
.footer { text-align: left; padding: 32px 0; max-width: 760px; margin: 0 auto; }
